description: This file defines the React component 'MultiverseExplorerView' for the explore UI in a career navigation app. It manages state, fetches data from APIs, handles bookmarks, and renders UI elements for exploring career paths, role recommendations, and a mindmap view, with support functions for path types and filtering.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string, defaulting to empty if null or undefined.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Safely converts an unknown value to an array of trimmed non-empty strings.

methods.name: roleIdFromRec
methods.description: Derives a role ID string from a recommendation object, with fallback.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRec
methods.description: Extracts the role title from a recommendation object.

methods.name: labelForPathType
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for a given path type.

methods.name: describePathType
methods.description: Provides a descriptive string for a specific path type.

methods.name: looksLikePathType
methods.description: Type guard that checks if a string matches known path types.

methods.name: pathMatchesFilters
methods.description: Filters paths based on search query, industry, and skills.

methods.name: PathCard
methods.description: React component rendering a path summary card with bookmarking feature.

methods.name: PathDetailPanel
methods.description: React component showing detailed info for a selected path, including steps and bookmarks.

methods.name: normalizeBackendBookmarksToLocal
methods.description: Converts backend bookmark records to local bookmark objects.

methods.name: normalizeRecommendedRoles
methods.description: Converts API recommendation data into a list of role objects.
